run_at.description: Absolute RFC3339 time for one-shot tasks (e.g. '2030-01-01T00:00:00Z').

command.description: Shell command to execute. Use 'command' for shell jobs OR 'prompt' for agent jobs.

prompt.description: Agent prompt for recurring agent tasks (e.g. reminders, briefings). Use this instead of 'command' for user-facing notifications.

name.description: Short human-readable name for the job (e.g. 'drink_water_reminder'). Always provide a name.
